notFound.title: Sorry, page not found
notFound.text: The page you are looking for might have been removed, had its name changed, or is temporarily unavailable. Please check the URL or go back to home.

error.title: Technical Error Occurred
error.text: An unexpected error occurred. Our engineering team has been notified and is working to fix it. Please try again later.

reasons.fetch_failed: Network connection issue or server is unresponsive.
reasons.auth_error: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
reasons.timeout: Connection to the server timed out.

offline.title: No internet connection
offline.text: You are not connected to the network. Please check your internet connection and refresh the page.
